attempts.reasoning:
We need produce heat_advisory JSON. Use up to 8 actions suitable for ORANGE highest. Choose most important: COMMS_PUBLIC_ANNOUNCE_ORANGE_RED, IMD_ORANGE_ADVICE, IMD_ORANGE_ORS_FLUIDS, NDMA_ORANGE_AVOID_EXPOSURE_HYDRATE, NAP_HOSP_AMBULANCE_ICE_PACKS_COLD_WATER, MUNI_WATER_TANKERS_SLUMS, SCHOOL_RESCHEDULE_TIMINGS, HEALTH_WEEKLY_IMPACT_REPORT. That's 8.

Day sentences: each one short, mention forecast max and colour? Must include colour name only that day's own colour. So for orange days include orange, for green days include green. No other colours. Provide one sentence per day.

Summary: 2-3 sentences: highest alert level, on which days, and what to watch. Use colour names only that occur: orange and green. Provide highest level orange on Sun Mon Tue. Watch heat exposure etc but not restate actions.

Let's craft.

Day1: "Sunday will see a maximum of 40 °C and an orange alert." (use rounded maybe 40). Use whole number.

Day2: similar.

Day3: similar.

Day4: "Wednesday will have a maximum of 40 °C with a green alert."

Day5: "Thursday will have a maximum of 40 °C with a green alert."

Summary: "Orange alerts are expected on Sunday, Monday and Tuesday. Expect temperatures around 40 °C and watch for heat exposure. Green alerts follow on Wednesday and Thursday."
